ddn@1.default_resolution: file > type-scoped CSS > profile standard > common standard; apply only applicable settings
profile_rules: Native DDN retains its complete 153-kind vocabulary, 91 relationship roles, facets, members, ports, samples, containment, routing, frames and embedded-view occurrences. A native dataset view role and a placed presentation view remain different concepts.
A name-only or unnamed entity is a valid draft. Display <table> for the unnamed title; do not infer required fields, types, primary keys or database bindings.
Draft/accepted state, look, body mode and visible detail columns are independent. Domain names can create reusable provisional domains.

Native ERD draft text converts to ordered field rows only on an explicit Columns command; preserve the draft text in undo history. Acceptance checks the selected scope and dependency revisions, never the whole workarea by default.
ddn@1.bounded_analysis: Core validation; the existing analysis/DDNA capabilities remain separate explicitly selected services, not implicit execution from drawing a connector.
designer_commands: Create a native object by role; first entity drop centers in the viewport.
Edit title in place; choose Draft, Columns, Column Detail, Comments, Constraints or Delete.
Edit draft lines and explicitly convert to fields; select Name/Type/Domain/Constraint/Key/Comment independently.
Create/rename/reuse provisional domains, connect typed endpoints, place frames and view occurrences; inspect source and change effects.
ddn@1.projection_operation: Create typed nodes/member ports and role-scoped connectors; select graph layout; retain legal frames/routes/placements.
ddn@1.geometry_editor: legal graph/frame/route/placement or interaction-order controls under the profile

matrix.relations@1.metadata_contract: metadata-index.json and exact role-contracts.json dispatch into ddn.schema.json; retained semantic owner predicates remain mandatory
matrix.relations@1.default_resolution: file > type-scoped CSS > profile standard > common standard; apply only applicable settings
profile_rules: Explicit ordered row/column references and one named relation role; direction is row→column.
Cells retain every contributing relationship ID and endpoint reference. Duplicate assignments reject unless explicitly join-enabled.
At most 5000 cells and 40 columns; a blank cell is missing, not an implied relationship.
matrix.relations@1.bounded_analysis: Deterministic assignment projection and profile-specific cell/domain/completion checks; no implied organizational authority or strategy optimizer.
designer_commands: Select/reorder row and column axes; create/edit/delete the source assignment for a cell; choose scalar value binding and duplicate policy.
matrix.relations@1.projection_operation: Declare ordered axes and assignment relation/value binding; one cell occurrence for each row/column pair; edits change assignments.
matrix.relations@1.geometry_editor: projection-specific controls only; no graph-only place/route/frame/subdiagram if planner rejects them

profile_rules: Marks bar/line/area/point/pie/donut bind explicit selected records. Numeric values must be finite numbers; numeric strings are not coerced.
x is category/number/date; point requires numeric x, bar/pie/donut category. Line/area may use category, number or UTC date.
Zero-baseline and arc share rules remain mark-specific; unit declarations must agree with supplied record units.
aggregate none/sum/count/min/max/mean is available only on supported bar/arc/top-k paths, with contributor IDs preserved; count has no physical unit.
Explicit empty records is legal for bar/line/area/point; filtering a nonempty selection to nothing is an error. Missing error/skip is explicit.
Add registered shared-scale series/layers, transforms and overlays. Each layer/transform must satisfy its exact schema; do not run author expressions.
Preserve computed-value provenance, missing-series behavior and bounded transform outputs. Trend/error annotations describe supplied data rather than causal proof.

Identity transform allows bar/line/area/point; one layer per series, at most 20 series and 200 coordinates. group/stack/percent/overlay share one y scale; series_missing is gap/zero/error. Stacks require complete or explicitly zero-filled data; percent requires nonnegative values and positive category totals.

Histogram transform uses measured y and 2..101 explicit increasing bin boundaries; count/proportion/density normalization, outside error/exclude, half-open bins with final upper inclusive. Pareto sums categories, orders descending (declaration-order ties), requires nonnegative values and positive total, and reports cumulative contributor sets.

Waterfall requires a step binding delta/subtotal/total and finite baseline default 0; subtotal/total values must match running total within relative tolerance 1e-10. Totals are not extra deltas. Boxplot transform requires box mark, R-7 quartiles and tukey_1_5 or minmax whiskers.

Nonidentity transforms reject series/layers/arrangement and transform-inapplicable properties; no aggregate property is emitted even as none. Resolve defaults conditionally before validation so omitted settings cannot inject illegal fields.
baseline_declared_validation: numeric domains, units, bin boundaries, totals, quartile/whisker conventions
chart.quality@1.bounded_analysis: Deterministic mark/transform calculations and bound checks, with contributor provenance; no arbitrary expressions, causal inference or operational execution.
designer_commands: Select records; bind channels and units; choose mark; edit source values; select filter/order/aggregate; inspect every mark contribution.
chart.quality@1.projection_operation: Bind source records to a typed active mark; preserve numeric plan, source contributors, units and missing-data policy. Layout comes from the plan.
chart.quality@1.geometry_editor: projection-specific controls only; no graph-only place/route/frame/subdiagram if planner rejects them

mindmap.basic@1.scope: One central topic with an acyclic single-parent tree, horizontal curved branches and optional typed links to external context. Root branches may grow left or right; descendants grow away from their incoming side.
mindmap.basic@1.edition: OPEN standalone; CLOSED adds shared services only
mindmap.basic@1.palette_interpretation: Primary roles are mind-map topics. Context roles must be linked directly to a selected topic; context does not become a second topic tree.

relation_endpoint_contracts.further_restrictions: Profile semantic rules and member/metadata-owner checks apply after registry checks.

mindmap.basic@1.metadata_contract: metadata-index.json and exact role-contracts.json dispatch into ddn.schema.json; retained semantic owner predicates remain mandatory
mindmap.basic@1.default_resolution: file > type-scoped CSS > profile standard > common standard; apply only applicable settings
profile_rules: Selected domain/entity/object/term definitions are topics. A link between two selected topics is internal; exactly one selected topic is an external link. Foreign context must be directly linked to a topic.

Internal links are assoc only. Require one topic root and no internal cycles. A topic may have at most one incoming selected relationship in total, including external links and duplicate links from the same parent. Explicit root must be the actual topic root.

Incoming and outgoing internal branches use opposite horizontal sides; the centre may have outgoing branches on both sides. Topic attachments never use top or bottom except a single incoming external link to the centre, which may attach at its top or bottom. Distinct attachments are evenly spaced along each occupied side.
Internal curves avoid crossings in automatic tree placement and have no relation types, names, numbers or legend entries. Only external relationships can create a legend.
The existing relation appearance route.source_side east/west can choose a root branch side. Omission alternates root branches; descendants continue outward.

Selected topics in the designer expose equally spaced circular add-left/add-right/delete/edit-name/note controls below the body. Add-left is available at the root or with incoming on the right; add-right is available at the root or with incoming on the left. The viewer and exports omit editing controls.

External links use existing native DDN role/endpoint contracts, retain applicable labels/legend entries and do not affect internal topic root or cycle counts. Incoming external links still count toward the single-incoming-relation limit.

Incompatible authored pins/routes are diagnosed when attachment and noncrossing constraints cannot be satisfied. Top/bottom is permitted only on the target of an incoming external link to the unique internal root.

Series links stay in the same rung; parallel OR branches follow declared topology. Jump target is a selected label.
Require ladder layout; render rails and right-aligned coil, contact/coil variants and hosted FBD pins.
baseline_declared_validation: each rung drives exactly one ladder.coil (DDN-PJ211)
ladder.series endpoints stay within one rung (DDN-PJ212)
ladder.basic@1.bounded_analysis: Structural verification and display only; no execution or implied process engine.
designer_commands: Create rung; add contact/coil/FBD/label/jump/return; connect series branches; edit contact form/coil mode/jump target.
ladder.basic@1.projection_operation: Create typed nodes/member ports and role-scoped connectors; select graph layout; retain legal frames/routes/placements.
ladder.basic@1.geometry_editor: legal graph/frame/route/placement or interaction-order controls under the profile

tests.name: power rails render and flank the rung area
NO/NC contact glyphs and coil mode variants render
negated coil renders a slash
rung layout: series runs left to right, coil is rightmost, label is leftmost
parallel OR branch: shared-junction contacts stack on separate tracks
rungs stack top to bottom in declaration order
fbd.block hosts on a rung with pin-level series wiring
jump and label render; jump target resolves (DDN-PJ213 ok path)
exactly one coil per rung (DDN-PJ211)
x_contact/x_coil apply to their ladder kinds only (DDN-PJ211)
series wiring cannot cross rungs (DDN-PJ212)
jump must target a selected ladder.label (DDN-PJ213)
the profile requires layout algorithm ladder (DDN-PJ214)

regression_suites.scope: Profile or shared-family regression source. Not every assertion in this suite targets this profile; supplemental witnesses separately prove profile dispatch.

acceptance_requirements: Replay baseline witness with matching profile, no placeholder and valid source IDs.
Preserve this profile's declared rules, algorithms, limits and negative suite results.
Verify omitted defaults and file > CSS > standard precedence without cross-profile leakage.
Keep viewer read-only; designer source mutations are undoable and revisioned.
Permit unfinished drafts; require profile completion checks before acceptance.
Maintain source/occurrence/contributor identity through edits, render and snapshot.
Reject invalid role/member endpoints and invalid metadata owners/types.
Preserve deterministic ordering, numeric plans and explicit unknown/missing states.
Apply publication font/extent/overflow checks and revision provenance.
ladder.basic@1.implementation_state: Existing scope evidenced by baseline tests/witnesses; redesigned defaults, palettes, guided edits, stage policy and new output adapters are specification requirements, not completed implementation.
